claim.claim-text: (a) a VlsE sequence of L-K-K-D-D-N-I-A-A-A-X<11>-V-L-R-G-X<16>-X<17>-K-D-G-X<21>-F-A- X<24>-X<25> (SEQ ID NO: 1), wherein X<11> is an amino acid selected from the group consisting of V and L, X<16> is an amino acid selected from the group consisting of L and I, X<17> is an amino acid selected from the group consisting of A and V, X<21> is an amino acid selected from the group consisting of R, D and N, X<24> is an amino acid selected from the group consisting of I, W, and Y, and X<25> is an amino acid selected from the group consisting of K and R; and (b) a sequence from at least one non-VlsE Borrelia antigen.
2. The isolated peptide of claim 1, wherein the VlsE sequence of 1(a) comprises the sequence of L-K-K-D-D-N-I-A-A-A-L-V-L-R-G-L-A-K-D-G-R-F-A-I-K (SEQ ID NO: 4).

3. The isolated peptide of claim 1 or claim 2, wherein the sequence from at least one VlsE Borrelia antigen comprises a peptide sequence from the Outer Surface Protein C (OspC) of Borrelia, optionally wherein the peptide sequence from the OspC is located at the N terminal of the isolated peptide.

4. The isolated peptide of claim 3, wherein the peptide sequence from the OspC comprises a sequence of n1-n2-S-P-n5-n6-P (SEQ ID NO: 149) or a fragment thereof, wherein n1 is an amino acid selected from the group consisting of A and V, n2 is an amino acid selected from the group consisting of E and D, n5 is an amino acid selected from the group consisting of K and R, and n6 is an amino acid selected from the group consisting of K and R.

5. The isolated peptide of any one of claims 1-4, wherein the sequence from at least one VlsE Borrelia antigen comprises a peptide sequence from p41 of Borrelia, optionally wherein the peptide sequence from p41 is located at the C terminal of the isolated peptide.
6. The isolated peptide of claim 5, wherein the peptide sequence from p41 comprises:

(i) a sequence of V-c2-E-G-c5-Q-Q-E-G-A-Q-Q-P-S-C (SEQ ID NO: 150) or a fragment thereof, wherein c2 is an amino acid selected from the group consisting of Q and R, and c5 is an amino acid selected from the group consisting of V and A; or (ii) a sequence of A-V-c3-E-G-c6-Q-Q-E-G-A-Q-Q-P-S (SEQ ID NO: 151) or a fragment thereof, wherein c3 is an amino acid selected from the group consisting of Q and R, and c6 is an amino acid selected from the group consisting of V and A.

7. The isolated peptide of claim 1, wherein the sequence from at least one non-VlsE Borrelia antigen includes each of: a sequence from p41 of Borrelia located at the C terminal of the isolated peptide and a sequence from OspC of Borrelia located at the N terminal of the isolated peptide wherein:

a) the OspC sequence comprises the sequence of n1-n2-S-P-n5-n6-P (SEQ ID NO: 149) or a fragment thereof, wherein n1 is an amino acid selected from the group consisting of A and V, n2 is an amino acid selected from the group consisting of E and D, n5 is an amino acid selected from the group consisting of K and R, and n6 is an amino acid selected from the group consisting of K and R; and b) the p41 sequence comprises either

i) the sequence V-c2-E-G-c5-Q-Q-E-G-A-Q-Q-P-S-C (SEQ ID NO: 150) or a fragment thereof, wherein c2 is an amino acid selected from the group consisting of Q and R, and c5 is an amino acid selected from the group consisting of V and A; or ii) the sequence A-V-c3-E-G-c6-Q-Q-E-G-A-Q-Q-P-S (SEQ ID NO: 151) or a fragment thereof, wherein c3 is an amino acid selected from the group consisting of Q and R, and c6 is an amino acid selected from the group consisting of V and A.
8. The isolated peptide of any one of claims 1-7, wherein said isolated peptide is conjugated to a ligand.
9. The isolated peptide of any one of claims 1-7, wherein said isolated peptide is biotinylated.

10. The isolated peptide of any one of claims 1-7, wherein said isolated peptide is conjugated to streptavidin or bovine serum albumin optionally via an additional terminal amino acid linking residue.

11. The isolated peptide of any one of claims 1-7, wherein said isolated peptide is attached or immobilized to a solid support, optionally wherein the isolated peptide is attached or immobilized to a bead, a flow path in a lateral flow immunoassay device, a well in a microtiter plate, or a flow path in a rotor.

12. A method for diagnosing Lyme disease in a subject, the method comprising: contacting a sample from the subject with the isolated peptide of any one of claims 1-11; and detecting formation of an antibody-peptide complex comprising the isolated peptide, wherein formation of the complex is indicative the subject having Lyme disease.
13. A kit comprising the isolated peptide of any one of claims 1-11 and a labeling reagent capable of binding to an antibody that recognizes an epitope of the isolated peptide.

14. The kit of claim 13, wherein the isolated peptide is attached to a solid support, optionally wherein the isolated peptide is attached to a bead, a tube, a well, a lateral flow assay device, or an analytical rotor.

15. The kit of claim 13 or claim 14, wherein the labeling reagent is (i) an anti-human or anti-canine IgG antibody conjugated to a detectable label or (ii) protein A and/or protein G conjugated to a detectable label, optionally wherein the detectable label is colloidal gold nanoparticles.
